title: Calculate completed credits per merchant
sqlValidation:
SELECT merchantId, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS totalCredits
FROM dbo.WalletTransactions
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND transactionType = 'credit'
GROUP BY merchantId
ORDER BY merchantId;
sqlExpectedResult: Totals match the expected credit ledger for each merchant.
